own_solution.law: Hard-sphere collision frequency z = sqrt(2) * pi d^2 * n * vbar, with n = P/(kT) and vbar = sqrt(8kT/(pi m))
assumptions: Maxwellian speeds (mean relative speed sqrt(2) vbar)
vessel much larger than mean free path

T209B.regime: vessel dimension (12 cm) >> mean free path (~85 nm); wall collisions negligible

T6ADA.regime: vessel dimension (12 cm) >> mean free path (~85 nm); wall collisions negligible

defect_reasons.other: T8E4F combines 'Before the collisions are counted' with 'for one run only', which leaves it slightly unclear whether the counted run is the one with the extra 33 kPa; read as the counted run, P = 113 kPa.

notes: n = P/kT = 1.931e25 m^-3; vbar = 476.4 m/s; sigma = pi d^2 = 4.301e-19 m^2; z = sqrt2*sigma*n*vbar = 5.595e9 s^-1. Mean free path ~ 85 nm. With 33 kPa more nitrogen at same T, P = 113 kPa and z scales with P: 5.595e9*113/80 = 7.902e9 s^-1. Volume cancels because n is fixed by P and T (C); width only matters if comparable to mean free path (K). TE094 and T62EC give no number ('a further small amount') while TA9C7 and T7923 give 33 kPa; if these are meant as variants of each other they differ in the stated quantity. Volume pair (T5675/T4C04) and width pair (T209B/T6ADA) state the same number and unit.
